meta.source: Written for the KERYX live operator console (Electron, Windows). Dark only.

tokens.name: bg-0
tokens.usage: Window ground behind the modules and the 8px gutters between panels. The top bar sits directly on it (no panel of its own).

tokens.name: bg-1
tokens.usage: Every module (panel) surface. Lists and monitors' captions sit on it; in the top bar, the search field and the screen glyphs' buttons.

tokens.name: bg-2
tokens.usage: Raised fields inside a panel: inputs, the search/command field, popovers and menus, hover tint of a row or glyph.

tokens.name: bg-3
tokens.usage: Pressed or selected neutral state (a selected tab, an open menu trigger, an active segment of a neutral switch). The fourth and last grey step.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: panel edges, row separators, the 1px frame of a neutral monitor. Decorative, never carries meaning.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: The 1px splitter line on hover, input borders on focus-less hover, the hatch of an empty monitor.

tokens.name: fg-1
tokens.usage: Content text (13–14px) and labels of the row in hand on bg-1, bg-2 and bg-3. 15.9:1 on bg-1.

tokens.name: fg-2
tokens.usage: UI labels (12px), glyphs at rest, clock digits. 7.2:1 on bg-3.

tokens.name: fg-3
tokens.usage: Metadata (11px), section headers, placeholder text, done items of the rundown. 4.9:1 on bg-3 — never go greyer than this for text.

tokens.name: air
tokens.usage: ON AIR (Programa). The 1px frame of the Programa monitor, the 2px left bar of the on-air row or slide, the on-air dot. A mark colour: 4.7:1 on bg-1.

tokens.name: air-fg
tokens.usage: Red text on bg-1/bg-2: the PROGRAMA caption, 'NO AR AGORA', the on-air row's title when it must read red. 6.5:1 on bg-1.

tokens.name: air-fill
tokens.usage: The only red fill: the Ao vivo segment of the mode switch and the 'NO AR AGORA' PiP label. Text on it is on-state (white, 5.0:1).

tokens.name: air-tint
tokens.usage: 10% red wash behind an on-air row, slide or rundown item, always paired with the 2px air bar on the left edge. Never alone.

tokens.name: prev
tokens.usage: PREPARED (Prévia). The 1px frame of the Prévia monitor, the 2px left bar of the prepared row/slide, the Conectada dot of an output. 5.8:1 on bg-1.

tokens.name: prev-fg
tokens.usage: Green text on bg-1/bg-2: the PRÉVIA caption, 'Conectada', the prepared item's time. 9.4:1 on bg-1.

tokens.name: prev-fill
tokens.usage: The only green fill: the 'Enviar ao ar' button. Text on it is on-state (white, 5.1:1).

tokens.name: prev-tint
tokens.usage: 10% green wash behind a prepared row, slide or rundown item, with its 2px prev bar.

tokens.name: rh
tokens.usage: REHEARSAL (Ensaio): outputs disarmed. Frame of the Programa monitor in Ensaio, the banner's top rule, the output status dot. 5.0:1 on bg-1.

tokens.name: rh-fg
tokens.usage: Blue text on bg-1/bg-2: the 'MODO ENSAIO' banner text, 'Saídas desarmadas'. 8.4:1 on bg-1.

tokens.name: rh-fill
tokens.usage: The Ensaio segment of the mode switch when Ensaio is on, and 'Armar saídas'. Text on it is on-state (white, 4.7:1).

tokens.name: rh-tint
tokens.usage: 10% blue wash of the Ensaio banner and of a rehearsed-only slide.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: WARNING or FAILURE: output reconnecting or disconnected, missing file, font not installed, running late. Dots, hatches, the 2px bar. 9.0:1 on bg-1.

tokens.name: warn-fg
tokens.usage: Amber text on bg-1/bg-2: 'Reconectando… tentativa 2', '+7 min atrasado', 'Arquivo não encontrado'. 11.5:1 on bg-1.

tokens.name: warn-tint
tokens.usage: 10% amber wash of the recovery banner and the reconnecting hatch (alternated with bg-0 stripes).

tokens.name: on-state
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on air-fill, prev-fill and rh-fill. Never on bg-1/bg-2 (use fg-1).

tokens.name: on-warn
tokens.usage: Text on a warn fill (the only warn fill is the amber PiP label 'Reconectando'). 9.1:1 on warn.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The KERYX gold: the logo mark, the active environment tab's underline, the 2px focus ring and the fill of ordinary (non-live) primary actions such as Salvar or Novo culto (kx-btn-brand). 5.5:1 on bg-3. Never Programa, Prévia, Enviar ao ar, Ensaio or a warning; one or two gold cues per region.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on a gold button.

tokens.name: brand-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed gold button (on-brand on it: 4.7:1). Never text on bg-2/bg-3.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: 10% gold wash, very sparse: behind the item chosen for editing, with a gold edge.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on brand fills: the gold button's label, the logo mark's K. 6.7:1 on brand.

tokens.name: screen-bg
tokens.usage: The black of a projected screen: Tela preta, the ground behind a background image, the letterbox of a monitor.

tokens.name: screen-fg
tokens.usage: Projected text: lyrics, verses, announcements on a background image, with the screen-text shadow.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Telemetry only: the grey line under a title, timestamps, counts, key, length, tooltips' shortcut. Never the name of what is on air or prepared (live-title, next-title). Always fg-3 or fg-2, always tabular numerals.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Module and section headers, uppercase, fg-3. The monitors' captions are live-cap + live-title / next-title + meta.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, menu items, inputs, the top bar. fg-2 at rest, fg-1 when the control is the one in hand.

styles.name: ui-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside UI text: the status label, the active segment of a switch, the primary button's label.

styles.name: content
styles.usage: Titles in lists: songs, media, rundown items, layers. fg-1.

styles.name: content-lg
styles.sample: Porque Deus amou o mundo de tal maneira…
styles.usage: Reading text: slide text in the slides column, Bible verses in the reading view. The largest size on the console except clocks.

styles.name: live-cap
styles.usage: The state word of a monitor (PROGRAMA, PRÉVIA), uppercase, in the state's text colour (air-fg, prev-fg, rh-fg).

styles.name: live-title
styles.usage: What is on air, once per screen: the title in the Programa's caption. fg-1.

styles.name: next-title
styles.usage: What is prepared and what comes next: the Prévia's caption and the Próximo line. fg-1.

styles.name: alert-title
styles.usage: What failed, in an output banner. The state's text colour.

styles.name: clock
styles.usage: The live clock in the top bar and the elapsed/planned figures of the timeline. Tabular numerals, fg-2.

styles.name: countdown
styles.usage: Countdowns and timers inside the console (never on the console for anything else). Tabular numerals.

styles.name: screen-lyrics
styles.sample: Tua voz me chama pelo nome
styles.usage: Lyrics on the projected 1920×1080 screen (scaled by the monitor: 5.2% of the screen width). screen-fg with the screen-text shadow.

styles.name: screen-verse
styles.sample: Porque Deus amou o mundo de tal maneira…
styles.usage: Bible text on screen; the reference line beneath it uses screen-ref.

styles.name: screen-ref
styles.usage: The reference under a projected passage and the song title on the first slide. Uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: The grid unit. Gap between a glyph and its label, between stacked rows of metadata.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of a row and a control; gap between controls in a group.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding of a popover or menu; gap between a module header and its first row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding of a dialog body; the width of an icon glyph.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Empty-state inset; vertical rhythm inside the brand book only.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: The gap between modules on the console grid and the inset of the grid from the window edge.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: Height of every row, control, tab, module header and the collapsed module. The timeline's default height.

tokens.name: row-comfortable
tokens.usage: List rows in the Confortável density (Ver › Densidade): 14px titles, up to two lines. Compacta keeps row (28px).

tokens.name: topbar
tokens.usage: Height of the top bar (it sits on bg-0, without a panel).

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: Width of the state bar on a row's left edge and of the focus ring.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menu items, slide rows, timeline blocks, the monitor's inner screen.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Modules, popovers, menus, dialogs, banners.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: State dots (6px), the scrub handle of the transport and the top bar's search field.

shadow.note: The console has no shadows inside panels. Popovers that float over the grid get one hairline-plus-ambient shadow so they separate from the module under them; projected text gets a text shadow for legibility on any background.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus, the outputs popover, the command palette, tooltips. The only box-shadow on the console.

tokens.name: screen-text
tokens.usage: A text-shadow (not a box-shadow) under projected lyrics and verses so screen-fg reads on bright backgrounds.

timing.note: One easing, one duration. Hover, focus, selection and state changes transition background-color, color and border-color over 120ms ease-out. Content on a projected screen never animates on the console: a slide change is a hard cut. prefers-reduced-motion: reduce removes the 120ms.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Every transition on the console.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: The only easing.

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Done items of the rundown and timeline, hidden layers, a disabled control. Applied to the whole row, text included.

tokens.name: hatch
tokens.usage: The amber hatch over a monitor whose output is reconnecting: the stripes let the last frame show through.
